answer: Make standing a trellis that reputation must climb slowly: each agent posts a refundable stake bond and can only ascend one terrace at a time as independent peers attest to real work across many epochs. A clone fleet cannot buy height, since every fake identity funds its own bond and waits its own vesting window. Lacking the thread of honest history, each sybil costs fresh capital and time per head, so the attack cost scales linearly instead of collapsing to near zero.
